messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED • high 5xx rate spikes on hosted inference (us-west-2). paging oncall: sara (oncall). root_ts=1803456789 :rotating_light:

incident-bot: Symptoms: 5xxs and latencies > 2s. Initial detection @ 2026-03-15T11:02:14Z. Alert rule: api_inference_5xx_rate > 5% over 5m.

sara (oncall): Ack. I’m on it. Pulling dashboards and recent deploys.

ops-bot: Recent deploys in us-west-2:
```
deploy-id: dpl-20260315-1100
component: runtime-serving
commit: 7ab3d2f
user: devin
```

sara (oncall): Noted deploy dpl-20260315-1100 at 11:00 UTC. Starting quick blast radius check.

devin (eng-runtime): I pushed that runtime patch for batching perf. Could be related. I’ll triage logs for KV cache errors.

lia (eng-ml): I’ll check model memory metrics and any recent variant swaps.

matt (eng-infra): I’m validating network/route tables and LB health checks.

kevin (cs): Heads up — two paying Dedicated customers reported increased errors via support. I’ll draft a status note once we have impact numbers.

sara (oncall): Quick numbers from observability (11:02-11:18 UTC):
- overall 5xx rate peaked 13%
- affected request volume ~ 8k rps -> ~960 rps errored
- error signature: 500 internal from runtime, traces show kv_cache miss exceptions in ~60% of sampled errors

devin (eng-runtime): seeing similar in logs. sample tail: 
```
[11:05:02Z] ERROR ServeLoop RequestId=abcd1234 :: kv_cache: read inconsistent length, expected 512 got 0
[11:05:02Z] WARN    ChunkedDispatch failing fallback to sync path
[11:05:03Z] ERROR OOM while allocating kv-cache buffer
```

devin (eng-runtime): hypothesis H1: batching/runtime patch (dpl-20260315-1100) introduced unsafe resize on KV cache causing corrupt reads -> 500s. Owner: devin.

lia (eng-ml): hypothesis H2: model shard variant auto-rollout bumped a slightly-larger memory footprint variant triggering OOMs under load. Owner: lia.

matt (eng-infra): hypothesis H3: upstream NLB health flapping caused retry storms and cache thrashing. Owner: matt.

sara (oncall): We'll track all three in-thread. Quick mitigations:
- scoped rollback candidate for runtime patch (H1).
- temporarily pin model variant to previous (H2) for affected model ids.
- scale LB capacity / enable session draining tuning (H3) to reduce retries.

devin (eng-runtime): Plan for H1: create a canary revert and deploy to single shard (shard-7) to validate. Steps:
1) git checkout -b revert/runtime-bugfix 7ab3d2f~1
2) bump image tag, deploy to shard-7 via deploy-bot canary CLI.
Command: `./deploy-bot canary --component runtime-serving --shard shard-7 --image runtime:7ab3d2f-revert`

lia (eng-ml): For H2 I’ll pin model-neo-small on the model-serving layer: `modelctl pin --model model-neo-small --version v3.2.1` for us-west-2. This takes ~30s to propagate.

matt (eng-infra): For H3 I’m temporarily increasing NLB target healthy threshold and enabling cross-zone to avoid hot spots. Also increasing connection draining to 60s. Will monitor.

ops-bot: Canary deploy started: dpl-20260315-1122 -> shard-7. Notified: devin, sara.

sara (oncall): Customer impact estimate update (11:27 UTC):
- 3 Dedicated customers experienced errors > 5% on inference endpoints (support cases #9842, #9843, #9844).
- Hosted free-tier saw transient errors but auto-fallback to smaller model maintained responses for ~70% of traffic.
- Mitigation priority: Dedicated customers > high, Hosted reduced largely by fallback.

kevin (cs): I posted interim note to the affected accounts: "We’re investigating elevated 5xxs — prioritized mitigation underway, ETA 30–45m. Will keep you updated."

devin (eng-runtime): Canary logs (shard-7) after revert: 
```
[11:25:12Z] INFO  runtime init complete
[11:25:13Z] INFO  kv_cache size=512 OK
[11:25:14Z] INFO  serving 0.8ms avg latency
```
No kv_cache corruption seen so far on canary.

sara (oncall): Good. Rolling the revert to two more shards (8,9) now. Matt please hold shard autoscaler steady while we roll.

matt (eng-infra): Holding autoscaler, increasing headroom.

lia (eng-ml): Pin reverted model variant done for affected models. Metrics show model memory utilization stable.

ops-bot: Rollout status: revert applied to shards 7,8,9. Monitoring for 10m.

sara (oncall): Early signal: overall 5xx down to 3% in us-west-2, latency back under 600ms. Customers reporting improvement.

kevin (cs): Customer #9842 confirms errors subsided after 11:30 UTC.

devin (eng-runtime): Conclusion for in-incident: H1 most likely root cause (runtime batching patch) — revert rollbacks reduced the error rate. H1 -> confirmed by canary and staged rollouts. H2/H3 mitigations remain precautionary.

sara (oncall): Actions and owners for post-incident RCA: 
- Root Cause Writeup (owner: devin) — include diff & unsafe resize spot, tests.
- Memory/regression tests (owner: lia) — add model stress tests against kv cache disabled toggles.
- Deploy safety net (owner: matt) — add pre-deploy canary gating for cache-impacting changes.
- Customer follow-up (owner: kevin) — formal notification and post-incident summary.

devin (eng-runtime): I’ll open a PR that reintroduces safer resize semantics and add unit + integration tests. PR: https://git.internal/r/12345 (placeholder).

sara (oncall): Handoff: I need to step out at 11:40 UTC — devin will take post-incident ownership for RCA coordination. I’m leaving live-monitoring on until full rollback verified.

devin (eng-runtime): Taking ownership. I’ll coordinate RCA doc and schedule follow-up async. Will tag lia/matt/kevin.

matt (eng-infra): I’ll keep infra mitigations live for 1h and then revert LB temporary configs if stable.

kevin (cs): I’ll send a customer postmortem draft within 2 business hours.

incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS • mitigated -> reduced error rate observed after revert. Incident assigned to devin for RCA. Closing live paging.

sara (oncall): Thanks team. Will add timeline bullets to the postmortem doc.

devin (eng-runtime): Timeline notes (to include):
- 11:00 UTC runtime patch dpl-20260315-1100 deployed
- 11:02 UTC alert fired 5xx > 5%
- 11:05–11:20 UTC triage and hypothesis forming
- 11:22–11:30 UTC canary revert on shard-7 -> healthy
- 11:30–11:36 UTC staged revert to shards 8,9 -> overall 5xx down
- 11:40 UTC oncall handoff to devin

sara (oncall): Adding: logs and commands collected saved to incident S3: s3://redwood-incidents/1803456789/artifacts (log bundle + metrics snapshots).

devin (eng-runtime): I’ll kick off postmortem template and loop in owners. Closing thread for live mitigation; preserving for RCA notes.

ops-bot: Incident closed (live mitigation) • incident-id: INC-20260315-37 • RCA owner: devin.

kevin (cs): Thanks all — will follow up with customer comms once I have the draft.

matt (eng-infra): Leaving final note: we should add a canary flag for any kv_cache related change to avoid wide blast radius next time.

devin (eng-runtime): Agreed — will add to action items.

sara (oncall): Signing off. Great quick collaboration.
